Where do uppercase letters come from?
Roman monumental capitals; Trajan Column (113 CE) canonical
Where do lowercase letters come from?
Carolingian minuscule (789 CE), revived as "antique" by Renaissance humanists
Why is Arabic font rendering complex?
4 positional forms per letter + connected cursive + RTL + bidi algorithm
Writing system with only consonants (Arabic, Hebrew, Phoenician)
Consonant-primary with inherent vowel; other vowels as diacritics (Devanagari)
Scripts encode sounds, syllables, morphemes, or words depending on language structure
Writing systems constrain what can be preserved across languages
Script forms coevolve with clay, papyrus, parchment, paper, movable type, and screens
Writing is a sign system layered over spoken language and visual convention
Modern typography depends on Unicode, shaping engines, fonts, and rendering stacks
